jobs.description:
Overview

Are you a seasoned product marketer with a passion for innovation and a track record of success in AI, data, and analytics? RealPage is seeking a Director of Product Marketing who will drive growth and customer adoption for our Agentic AI solutions within the Multifamily real estate industry. This is a mission-critical, high visibility and high impact role.

The Lumina AI Workforce is a growing team of digital Agents built to handle routine tasks across leasing, operations, facilities, finance, and resident support. As a strategic cross-functional partner, you’ll drive alignment across our go-to-market, product, sales and operational teams, bring in the voice of the customer and market expertise into spearheading the launch of innovative products, build product marketing collateral, partner with sales enablement to ensure a strong mindshare and market share with our customers.

Responsibilities

Go-to-Market Programs: Define, plan, and execute go-to-market for a set of integrated products, in partnership with Product Management, Marketing and Sales/Account Management teams.
Product Messaging / Positioning: Develop succinct, compelling, and differentiated product messaging, positioning in the market, supported by measurable proof points.
Marketing and Sales Content: Develop and deliver high-impact assets such as presentations, case studies, battlecards, playbooks, and competitive assessments.
Sales Enablement Training: Create sales and customer success training materials that cover industry trends, buyer personas, pain points, solutions, sales plays, and competitive differentiation.
Voice of the Customer: Engage with customers at events and through key touch points to drive awareness to adoption. Be the champion of our customers with internal stakeholders.
Marketing Strategy: Collaborate with Demand Generation, developing strategies to target accounts and segments, messaging, and promotions to generate quality leads.
Competitive Intelligence: Provide an informed point of view and deliverables articulating where competition is headed or will emerge, and how to win at an individual account and competitor level.
Digital Journey Design: Co-create world-class marketing websites that reflect a deep understanding of the prospect/buyer, their personas and content needs across all stages of the buying cycles.
Product Strategy Support: Be a valued partner to Product Management in identifying and prioritizing product capabilities required to address customer needs. Drive clarity around market trends, customer needs, and industry best practices.
Product Launch Leadership: Tier the launch of products, align resources to the opportunity, identify and analyze KPIs to measure effectiveness and identify areas to improve.

Qualifications

~10 years of experience in B2B SaaS product marketing.
Mastery of foundational product marketing skills including value proposition development, GTM strategy, audience segmentation, product launches, content creation, sales enablement, and market research.
Track record of building strong relations with product management, sales, and cross-functional teams.
Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills.
Strong project management skills to plan and execute multiple workstreams simultaneously.
Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, computer science, or engineering.
An MBA is a plus but not required.
Prior experience launching AI-based products is a plus but not required.
Experience marketing software solutions in Multifamily property management is a plus but not required.

Additional Skills/Abilities

Creative storyteller who can craft elegant and compelling messages for complex products and succinctly distill complex concepts.
Strong analytical mind, skilled in assessing problems and making recommendations supported by data.
Comfort with technology – unafraid to dig into the product and learn the UI/UX, key workflows and what value it delivers to customers.
Persuasive personality that can confidently take a seat at the table and be a creative and thoughtful partner with stakeholders, regardless of their job title.
Deep understanding of B2B marketing and sales processes, how best to support sales teams and equip them for success.
Pragmatic self-starter that is outcomes-oriented and can juggle multiple work streams.
Ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams effectively to deliver required results.
Excellent collaborator that values relationships and takes pride in helping others succeed by being the lynchpin across teams.
Passion for growth, excellence, and continuous improvement of the current state of the business.

Salary And Benefits

RealPage provides a competitive salary package along with a comprehensive benefit plan that includes:
Health, dental, and vision insurance.
Retirement savings plan with company match.
Paid time off and holidays.
Professional development opportunities.
Performance-based bonus based on position.

Compensation may vary depending on your location, qualifications including job-related education, training, experience, licensure, and certification, that could result at a level outside of these ranges. Certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including annual bonus, and sales incentives depending on the terms of the applicable plan and role as well as individual performance.

About the Role

Saras Micro Devices is a venture-backed semiconductor startup. We are developing high-performance computing (HPC), package-integrated, power delivery solutions for artificial intelligence (AI) and advanced networking devices. We're looking for a Marketing Communications Manager to own the company's external voice — delivering high impact content that supports the business in achieving its corporate objectives and help drive customer success. Your responsibilities will include technical messaging and communications, technical copywriting, content/collateral creation, website planning and content management, social media, and events. Key objectives will be to build brand awareness, reputation and trust to drive demand for our products among design engineers and technical buyers across our target customers and markets. This is a highly cross-functional role, partnering closely with product management, applications engineering, and sales to translate deep technical products into clear, compelling content and campaigns.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute an integrated marketing communications plan that supports business priorities across communication platforms.

Content & Collateral

Develop, create and re-use compelling key messages and content for all platforms including blog articles, website content/updates, newsletter/direct mailing programs, explanation/technology videos, infographics, etc
Ensure editorial quality copywriting that’s on brand and messaging, ensuring concise and easy to understand technical topics suitable for audiences at multiple levels of knowledge and experience
Own creation and maintenance of technical marketing collateral in partnership with product management and applications engineering; , application notes, white papers, selector guides, and technical briefs
Develop sales enablement materials in collaboration with product marketing and applications engineering: product briefs, presentations, battle cards, and FAQs
Drive approval loop processes

Product Launches

Lead go-to-market product launch campaigns for new products and product families, coordinating timing across product marketing/management, engineering, and business development
Develop launch messaging and positioning that differentiates against competitive parts

PR & Industry Presence

Manage relationships with PR agencies, including press releases, media outreach, and analyst briefings
Manage events, conference attendance and tradeshow presence — booth materials, demos, speaking submissions, press interactions
Track and report on media coverage, share of voice, and industry visibility relative to competitors

Digital & Demand Generation

Develop and manage content strategy for website and social platforms, ensuring accurate product positioning and technical credibility
Manage demand gen campaigns, webinars, and content syndication to generate and nurture design-in leads
Own or collaborate on the company’s social media presence to support building brand recognition, product promotion and nurture the customer journey
Set marketing performance metrics (web traffic, content downloads, lead quality), track and report on effectiveness

Qualifications:

Required

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Electrical Engineering, or related field
5+ years of marketing communications experience in semiconductors or a related technical B2B industry (test & measurement, electronic components, embedded systems)
Strong writing, editing, and storytelling skills with a demonstrated ability to synthesize complex technical information into clear, engaging content, adapted for multiple audiences and channels
Proven project management skills with the ability to execute multiple initiatives simultaneously.
Experience with PR processes, press releases, and media/analyst relationships
Comfortable working directly with engineers to extract and validate technical content

Preferred

Familiarity with power electronics or analog/power semiconductor concepts (efficiency, thermal, switching topologies) sufficient to write credibly for an engineering audience
Prior experience at an early-stage or scaling semiconductor company
Trade show / conference program management experience specific to the semiconductor and electronics industries

What We Offer

Competitive salary and equity
Comprehensive health benefits
High-visibility role with direct influence on company narrative and market presence
Opportunity to build and shape the marcom function

jobs.title: Regional Marketing Associate
jobs.description:
IXL Learning, developer of personalized learning products used by millions of people globally, is seeking a full-time Regional Marketing Associate to help drive regional marketing initiatives that support our K–12 sales team and strengthen IXL's presence with districts across the country.

In this role, you'll partner closely with sales teams to understand regional priorities, identify opportunities, and execute targeted marketing campaigns that engage educators, generate leads, and advance sales opportunities. You'll develop compelling marketing materials, coordinate campaigns across channels, and help tailor national initiatives to meet regional needs. You'll also support IXL's expanding portfolio of educational products, including core curriculum and assessment solutions.

We're looking for a creative, proactive, and highly organized marketer who is an excellent communicator, thrives on collaboration, and is passionate about improving education.

This is a full-time position that requires you to be in our Raleigh, NC area office.

What You'll Be Doing

Plan and execute targeted regional marketing campaigns that support sales pipeline development, strengthen customer relationships, and help advance strategic district opportunities
Build strong partnerships with regional sales teams to understand their goals, customer needs, and opportunities for marketing support
Proactively recommend effective marketing tactics and materials that help sales teams engage prospects and move opportunities forward
Write compelling marketing copy and collaborate with designers and other marketing teams to develop and launch high-quality campaigns and sales materials
Coordinate with the email marketing team to plan and execute timely, targeted email campaigns that support regional sales initiatives
Partner with the events team to support marketing and sales events, including promotional outreach, lead tracking, and post-event sales follow-up
Stay informed about regional market trends, district priorities, and customer feedback, and use these insights to recommend relevant marketing opportunities
Track the performance of regional marketing campaigns, including engagement, lead activity, and sales feedback, and use those insights to improve future efforts

What We're Looking For

BA/BS degree
2–4 years of marketing experience in a professional environment, preferably in a role involving campaign execution or field marketing
Experience partnering with or supporting a sales team is a plus
Collaboration: You're an effective communicator who builds strong working relationships and collaborates well across teams
Ownership and execution: You're a proactive self-starter who can take a project from initial idea through launch, manage competing deadlines, and deliver high-quality work with minimal oversight
Problem-solving: You're resourceful, thoughtful, and comfortable researching new topics, identifying solutions, and finding efficient ways to get things done
You have knowledge of, or an interest in, education/edtech and can learn about the industry quickly
Experience with Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides

About IXL Learning

IXL Learning is the country's largest EdTech company. We reach millions of learners through our diverse range of products. For example:

1 in 4 students in the United States uses IXL.com
Rosetta Stone provides an immersive learning experience for 25 languages
Wyzant is the nation's largest community of tutors, covering 300+ subjects
Teachers Pay Teachers (TPT) is a comprehensive marketplace for millions of educator-created resources

Our mission is to create innovative products that will make a real, positive difference for learners and educators and we're looking for passionate, mission-minded people to join us in achieving this goal. We have a unique culture at IXL that fosters collaboration and the open exchange of ideas. We value our team and treat one another with kindness and respect. We approach our work with passion, tenacity, and authenticity. We find it immensely satisfying to develop products that impact the lives of millions and we are eager to have you join our team.

At IXL, we value diversity in age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, physical and mental ability, political and religious beliefs, and life experience, and we are proud to promote a work environment where everyone, from any background, can do their best work. jobs.title: Director of Digital Marketing
jobs.description:
Job Summary
The Director of Digital Marketing helps translate Midwest Veterinary Supply’s Marketing strategy into an integrated digital demand and customer engagement capability. In partnership with the VP of Marketing, this role helps develop and execute digital plans that strengthen the digital customer experience, increase awareness and engagement, support lead generation and conversion, and contribute to business growth. The Director leads digital marketing channels and programs, including website and digital experience, SEO/SEM, paid digital media, email and marketing automation, social media management, and analytics. The role works closely with Marketing Services, Brand Engagement, Sales, ecommerce and technology partners to connect customer needs, content and campaigns across the buying journey and to use performance insights to continually improve results.

This is a remote position. Candidates must reside in one of the following states: Alabama, Arkansas, California, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, or Wisconsin.
Core ResponsibilitiesDigital Strategy & Integrated Campaigns

Partner with the VP of Marketing to develop, refine and execute digital marketing plans aligned with business priorities and the broader Marketing strategy.

Translate business goals into integrated digital campaigns that attract, engage, convert and retain customers.

Coordinate digital plans with Marketing Services and Brand Engagement so manufacturer programs, content, creative and digital activation work together.

Monitor digital trends, customer behavior, competitor activity and emerging technologies to identify relevant opportunities for Midwest.

Digital Customer Experience & Web

Guide the ongoing improvement of website content, navigation, functionality and user experience in partnership with relevant business and technology teams.

Use customer insights, analytics and feedback to identify opportunities to improve digital journeys, usability, engagement and conversion.

Coordinate with ecommerce and business solutions stakeholders to support connected customer experiences across relevant digital platforms, clarifying ownership and dependencies across teams.

Develop and maintain SEO strategies and coordinate search engine marketing to improve discoverability and qualified traffic.

Digital Demand Generation & Channel Management

Plan, execute and optimize paid search, display, retargeting, paid social, email and other digital campaigns as appropriate to business needs.

Lead social media channel planning and management, including editorial calendars, publishing coordination, engagement monitoring and performance evaluation.

Partner with Sales and other stakeholders to support lead generation, nurture programs, customer engagement and campaign follow-through.

Coordinate channel plans, audience targeting, messaging and campaign schedules with content and creative partners.

Analytics, Measurement & Optimization

Establish and monitor meaningful digital performance indicators, reporting on traffic, engagement, conversion, campaign effectiveness and business outcomes.

Use tools such as web analytics, advertising platforms, CRM and marketing automation systems to evaluate performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

Provide actionable insights and recommendations to the VP of Marketing and cross-functional partners.

Support a culture of testing, learning and continuous improvement, using data to guide channel and campaign optimization.

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

Lead, coach and develop the Digital Marketing team, setting clear expectations, supporting professional growth and fostering collaboration and accountability.

Help establish team priorities, capacity planning, operating processes and work intake in alignment with Marketing-wide priorities set by the VP of Marketing.

Partner with Brand Engagement on content and creative needs and with Marketing Services on manufacturer-funded campaigns and demand generation.

Collaborate with ecommerce, IT, Sales, analytics and other stakeholders to clarify responsibilities, coordinate dependencies and improve the customer journey.

Evaluate digital tools, platforms and emerging capabilities with the VP of Marketing and relevant partners, recommending improvements based on business needs and expected impact.

Supervisory Responsibilities
Provides day-to-day leadership, coaching, work direction and performance feedback for assigned team members; supports hiring, onboarding, development and performance management in partnership with the VP of Marketing and Human Resources.

Organizational Competencies
Performs responsibilities professionally and in a manner consistent with the needs of internal and external customers and Midwest Veterinary Supply policies, procedures and values. Demonstrates sound judgment, collaboration, accountability, adaptability and a commitment to the fiscal health of the company.

Job Requirements & QualificationsEducation
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Experience, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

7+ years of progressive digital marketing experience, including strategy, campaign management, digital experience and analytics; leadership experience preferred.

Demonstrated experience across digital demand generation, website and content management, SEO/SEM, paid media, email/marketing automation and social media.

Experience translating business objectives into integrated digital plans, managing budgets and using performance data to improve results.

Working knowledge of web analytics, advertising platforms, CRM and marketing automation tools, and content management systems.

Strong people leadership, project prioritization, communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Ability to balance strategic thinking with practical execution in a changing, multi-stakeholder environment.

Preferred Qualifications

B2B marketing experience; animal health, veterinary, healthcare or distribution experience strongly preferred.

Experience supporting ecommerce or digital customer platforms and collaborating with Sales, IT, product or business solution teams.

Relevant certifications in Google Analytics, Google Ads or other digital marketing platforms.

Mental and Physical Demands

Ability to manage multiple priorities, analyze information, solve problems and make sound decisions in a fast-paced environment.

Regular collaboration with team members and internal and external stakeholders.

Prolonged periods of sitting and working on a computer; occasional travel to meetings, conferences or marketing events may be required.

Work Environment
This position may be performed in-office, hybrid or remotely, depending on business needs and company policy.

Job duties and requirements may be subject to modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. Requirements are representative of the minimum levels of education, experience and skills required to perform the essential functions of this job. The job description does not constitute a written or implied contract of employment. Midwest Veterinary Supply reserves the right to revise or change job duties and responsibilities as the need arises
.

Salary/Benefits
:     

We offer competitive pay and a comprehensive benefits package including Medical, Dental and Vision insurance, Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) insurance, Short- and Long-Term Disability insurance, a 401k plan, paid holidays, and Paid Time Off (PTO).  Our work environment is business casual, and we like to have fun with weekly relaxed dress days, monthly breakfasts and birthday celebrations, and regular events like holiday contests, cookouts, and employee appreciation celebrations.  

About Us
:

Midwest Veterinary Supply, Inc. (MVS) has provided quality service and merchandise to the veterinary profession since 1961. Our products are distributed from eight branches located in key geographic locations within our trade area. We take great pride in getting our orders out the same day as called in and having the product in the customer's hand the next day. MVS carries products and equipment from most major manufacturers. As we continue to grow, our goal will be, as it has always been, to provide the veterinary profession the very best in service along with quality merchandise at fair and competitive prices. 

Midwest Veterinary Supply believes in providing equal employment opportunities for all employees and will not violate any law prohibiting discrimination for or against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of any characteristic protected under local, state, or federal statute, ordinance, or regulation.  To view applicable employment notices, please click here to visit our Careers page.  California residents, click here to view the California Consumer Privacy Act Disclosure.

Come be part of a mission, not just a job, where you can: Shape your own future, build the next big thing, and change the world.

Job Description

Vantor is seeking a Marketing Specialist to turn business priorities into integrated campaigns that engage distinct government and commercial audiences and contribute to measurable business growth. This role will develop audience-centered campaign plans, coordinate execution across marketing and revenue teams, and connect every activation to a clear conversion path, lead follow-up plan and performance framework. Reporting to Claudette Allingham, this person will bring structure, urgency and sound judgment to multiple concurrent initiatives while helping the global marketing team build repeatable campaign practices.

Responsibilities

Translate business priorities into integrated, audience-specific campaigns that connect customer needs, Vantor capabilities and desired business outcomes.
Develop campaign briefs that define the target audience, customer need, use case, product, business outcome, channel strategy, call to action, owners and success measures.
Coordinate campaign execution across Content, Creative, Product Marketing, PR, Digital, Events, Partners, Sales and Business Development to deliver one connected Vantor story.
Maintain campaign calendars, project plans, approvals, dependencies and budgets, and coordinate agency or vendor support as needed.
Establish a clear conversion path, lead follow-up plan and return-on-investment measurement approach for every campaign.
Partner with Sales, Business Development and Sales Development teams to align lead capture, qualification, routing, nurturing and follow-up processes.
Coordinate CRM, marketing automation, account-based marketing and campaign data requirements with the appropriate functional owners.
Track engagement, qualified meetings, opportunity creation, influenced pipeline and revenue contribution; communicate results and actionable insights to stakeholders.
Use performance data to refine audience targeting, messaging, channels, tactics and investment throughout the campaign lifecycle.
Help establish reusable campaign playbooks, operating processes and standards while independently managing competing priorities and sustaining momentum.

Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business or a related field and at least 3 years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience planning and executing integrated, multichannel marketing campaigns with defined audiences, objectives, calls to action and success measures.
Demonstrated ability to develop clear campaign briefs and translate business priorities into coordinated marketing activities and deliverables.
Strong cross-functional project-management skills, including experience managing calendars, dependencies, approvals, budgets and multiple deadlines.
Working knowledge of demand-generation practices and the lead lifecycle, including capture, qualification, routing, nurturing and sales follow-up.
Ability to interpret campaign and funnel performance data, identify practical insights and recommend changes to targeting, messaging, channels or investment.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently with urgency in a fast-moving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting campaigns for government and commercial audiences, particularly in technology, aerospace, geospatial intelligence, defense or another complex business-to-business market.
Experience coordinating campaign data and workflows across customer relationship management, marketing automation and account-based marketing platforms.
Familiarity with pipeline attribution, influenced-revenue reporting, campaign dashboards and return-on-investment analysis.
Experience partnering directly with Sales, Business Development or Sales Development teams on account targeting and lead follow-up.
Experience managing agency or vendor relationships and tracking campaign budgets.
Experience creating campaign playbooks, templates or operating standards for a distributed or global marketing organization.

Description

Do you want to support Amazon’s mission to build the world’s safest, most efficient, and sustainable delivery network by helping our Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) build safe, quality businesses while retaining teams of satisfied and engaged drivers? We are looking for a Senior Marketing Communication Manager, DSP Experience who works to support 2,500+ DSPs who employ 175,000+ Delivery Associates (DAs) operating Prime-branded vehicles on road, delivering tens of millions of packages per week through our Last Mile delivery network.

Specifically, this candidate will work across multiple stakeholders and use communication strategies to bring to life all the ways that Amazon is investing in the DSP and DA experience. You will thrive in ambiguity to translate technical and operational information via the Change Management process into user-friendly resources and communications to make it convenient and seamless for DSPs to manage their business.

You’ll also help shape the team’s emerging Marketing Communications initiatives, helping ensure that we not only get the right candidates in the top of our marketing funnel so they apply for the program, but keep them engaged when they go to the bench to wait for the right opportunity to launch their DSP business. You’ll help build ongoing engagement and field marketing initiatives that are deployed to DSPs once they launch their business, supporting them through various marketing communication tactics across their full lifecycle.

In addition, you’ll serve as a primary liaison for the DSP Org to the broader transportation organization’s Day 1 initiatives, helping ensure that our VP’s entire organization remains plugged in and active to these initiatives to drive employee engagement and culture.

The ideal candidate must be a strong communicator with strategic communications and/or marketing communications experience, business acumen, and excellent writing ability – one who is able to flex between internal and external communication modalities. Not only will you need to help strategize on plans, you’ll need to help program manage them from ideation to execution to keep things on track. You will be a thought leader who indexes high on emotional intelligence and professionalism as you’ll be interacting with leaders at the highest levels. You’ll have to be comfortable with testing, learning, and rolling up your sleeves. Our environment is fast-paced and requires a candidate who isn’t afraid to innovate and propose disruptive ideas. You’ll also have a passion for fostering a collaborative and engaged culture and be a catalyst in bringing that to life. You’ll need to be able to influence teammates up, down, and across to buy-into the mission and prioritize it among the other day-to-day responsibilities.

This role can be based in Nashville, TN or Bellevue, WA.

Key job responsibilities

Develop a multi-channel strategy, including written communications and executive messaging
Translate complex messaging into simple and easy-to-understand content to help launch new programs and products
Identify emerging topics and develop proactive plans with stakeholders
Drive creative campaigns to both solve business needs and instill passion among the DSP community
Partner with stakeholders to ingest customer listening data and use it to inform a communication strategy
Monitor and measure the effectiveness of communications and other engagement tactics
Partner with agencies and internal creative teams to develop compelling content and partner engagement strategies – both for acquisition and ongoing lifecycle purposes
Develop team culture and employee engagement opportunities aligned to a broader org strategy

A day in the life

We write a lot and "are right a lot!” We respond to business needs and develop messaging for change announcements. We also interview DSPs and DAs to build compelling spotlight and advocacy stories. We own multiple channels by which we communicate to DSP Owners and their teams of DAs, partnering across our DSP Experience (DSPX) team to turn the flywheel that attracts, engages, equips, empowers, advocates, and inspires.

About The Team

The Americas DSP Marketing Communications team is made up of 20+ high performing leaders. Even though we are based in different cities across the U.S., Canada, and LATAM, we have a highly inclusive and collaborative culture. We approach each other with respect and humility and have fun every day by answering Questions of the Day (QOTD) in Slack to stay connected across multiple locations, sharing memes, and hosting interactive team building events. DSPs & DAs count on us to provide helpful and trustworthy information so they can operate their business efficiently and focus on what matters most to them, i.e., building a safety-first culture, developing their team and delivering millions of smiles in their communities.

8+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
Experience communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred Qualifications

Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners
Experience designing and executing joint marketing plans with strategic alliance partners with global footprint
Experience executing scaled marketing campaigns through email or social media
Experience with test and learn, marketing optimization, and experimentation

jobs.description:
At Sonos we want to create the ultimate listening experience for our customers and know that it starts by listening to each other. As part of the Sonos team, you’ll collaborate with people of all styles, skill sets, and backgrounds to realize our vision while fostering a community where everyone feels included and empowered to do the best work of their lives.

This role is a hybrid position

Some roles require an office while others may be done remotely. This position is considered hybrid, allowing for a combination of remote work and in-office collaboration. Qualified applicants must live within commuting distance of New York or Boston.

The Role

At Sonos, Product Marketing manages and captures the collision of product development, audience insights and brand storytelling.

The Product Marketing Director is the most senior member of the Product Marketing team and takes on the responsibility of leading the team, the process and cross functional relationships to deliver clear product positioning and a toolkit of creative assets that the entire organization uses to take the products to market. This role reports directly to the VP of Global Brand Strategy and is responsible for ensuring that every piece of Sonos hardware and every software initiative have a clearly defined role in the Sonos system and in people’s homes and lives, and that the features and functionality that differentiate each product are communicated in clear and compelling ways.

The role is different from many organizations in that it shifts the focus of Product Marketing upstream – leaning into strategic positioning early in the product development cycle, and handing responsibility for go-to-market planning, production and deployment to our consumer marketing and creative teams.

What You'll Lead The Team To Deliver

You’ll be responsible for managing the team and defining and overseeing processes and deliverables across the following:

Own the Global Product/System Narrative Arc from Current Positioning to Future State Positioning

Partner with Brand Strategy to intimately understand and contribute to brand narrative based on new products and their role in the system as well as new audiences that these products can attract
Collaborate with Product Owners to develop the authoritative product narrative for key product and software innovations. This is the core story at the intersection of the product truth, the audience, and brand to drive downstream product feature prioritizations and decisions, naming, launch briefs, regional adaptations, and channel executions
Ensure product narratives include audience insights and system thinking – not just specs, commercial objectives or competitive landscape
Partner with the Product Owner, Product Finance & Insights teams to ensure all relevant product, competitive, and commercial intelligence has been gathered and synthesized to inform product narrative, pricing, business case and investment recommendations
Maintain narrative coherence as products move from launch into their commercial lifecycle

Lead the Learning Agenda (and contribute to the execution of research)

Collaborate with UX and Insights teams to develop research plans through the product lifecycle
Participate and provide input as research is executed
Interrogate and utilize research findings to inform narratives, audience definitions and insights and strategies for products and launch moments
Deliver audience and cultural insights around the intelligent home, privacy, home audio and other relevant topics

Own the Product Toolkit

Work with creative team to develop an insightful, system-led toolkit for each product that includes
Relevant Product Narratives for both hardware and software features and experiences
Key product stories and copy libraries for key communication channels
Product visual assets and demonstration content
Audience definition and insights
Commercial and competitive analysis

Collaborate with Product, Revenue, Training, Consumer Marketing, Commercial Marketing and Comms throughout the Toolkit development process to ensure strategic alignment and inclusion of the right executional deliverables to meet each team’s needs

Partner with Marketing Teams to Define Success

Ensure that all campaigns, programs and activations have clear and measurable KPIs that align with strategic objectives (some products play a role in the portfolio that goes beyond direct revenue generation)
Leverage performance learnings for future product strategies and positioning

Inspire Creative Teams

Partner with creative teams as a strategic collaborator and product expert
Inspire and champion product storytelling that is brand-true, product correct, unexpected and compelling
Maintain a high bar for creative quality while keeping work anchored to strategic intent

Enable Regional and Segment Marketing

Provide consumer, professional, and retail marketing teams with the strategic context and baseline assets they need to adapt global direction for their channels and markets

What This Role Is — And Is Not

This role is:

The relentless driver of clarity
The owner of the global product narrative and the creative toolkit that will be used to bring the product to market globally
The integrator of brand strategy, product truth, and audience intelligence
A strategic partner to product teams, creative teams, global and regional marketers, and commercial leaders

This role is not:

A campaign manager or executional owner
A media or channel planner
A claims validator or Legal liaison
A substitute for GTM ownership, which lives with segment marketing teams

What You Bring

15+ years experience in product marketing and delivery of product marketing assets in global, product-led organizations that involve both hardware and software elements
5+ years managing a product marketing team in a relevant environment
Demonstrated experience defining, optimizing and deploying process and deliverables with cross-functional teams and stakeholders
A track record of developing product narratives that inspire breakthrough product demonstration, explanation and onboarding content
Ability to identify, gather, evaluate, and synthesize product, competitive, audience and cultural intelligence across multiple sources within the cross-functional team and from outside sources
Experience integrating audience inputs from multiple sources (product, commercial, media) into a unified strategic point of view
Proven ability to partner with and inspire creative teams
Proven ability to simplify process and org structure complexity into clear, action-oriented ways of working for a PMM team
Clear, confident communication skills as a manager and across senior leadership and cross-functional teams

Leadership Profile

Product-rigorous and brand-fluent
Comfortable defining and evolving process. Or navigating a complete lack of process
Concise communicator. Brevity = Clarity
Ability to generate and inspire unexpected ways of communicating and demonstrating product capabilities
Energized by the upstream and comfortable doing consequential work before anyone can see where it's going
A generous, elevating strategic partner who collaborates and shares, but also knows how to manage (and sometimes graciously decline to use) feedback in order to make the team and the work better
High standards for both strategic thinking and creative quality

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager,  DSX OS
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join the NVIDIA DSX Platform team.. This role is for a strong technical marketer who understands AI infrastructure and can turn complex platform capabilities into clear positioning, compelling narratives, and high-quality go-to-market execution. As part of NVIDIA DSX, DSX OS spans the IaaS and PaaS layers, providing the building blocks for provisioning, GPU health, multi-tenancy, and observability. DSX OS is a portfolio of open-source, modular, composable infrastructure software that helps cloud partners and infrastructure ISVs build, scale, and operate AI factories faster. The portfolio spans IaaS and PaaS layers, with building blocks for provisioning, lifecycle management, GPU health, observability, resiliency, and multi-tenant operations.

DSX OS is crafted to strengthen partner platforms, not replace them. In this role, you will lead product marketing for key DSX OS initiatives across infrastructure software, ecosystem enablement, and partner adoption. You will define positioning and messaging, develop launch plans, compose technical and business narratives, and build high-impact assets for NVIDIA Cloud Partners (NCPs), cloud service providers (CSPs), infrastructure ISVs, and internal field teams. You will work closely with product management, engineering, developer relations, business development, PR, analyst relations, campaigns, and sales to bring recently developed infrastructure solutions and ecosystem stories to market. This is a highly cross-functional role that requires both strategic judgment and hands-on execution. The right candidate can go deep on architecture, understand operator struggles, and translate platform capabilities into clear customer value.

What You’ll Be Doing

Orchestrate the positioning and narrative for DSX OS components, building value propositions that connect with both technical operators and business leaders.
We will work together to launch new infrastructure software, where you will guide the go-to-market execution and ensure our messaging is consistent across blogs, web content, and partner materials.
Cultivate deep collaborations with NVIDIA Cloud Partners (NCPs), CSPs, and infrastructure solution providers. Develop joint stories that highlight how we accelerate time to deployment and operational maturity.
By translating sophisticated GPU clusters and Kubernetes architectures into clear business value, your work will serve as the essential bridge between our engineering breakthroughs and the broader AI ecosystem.

What We Need To See

12+ years of experience in B2B product marketing, technical marketing, or related roles within cloud/AI infrastructure or platform software.
Bachelor’s degree in a technical or business field, or equivalent experience.
Technical Curiosity: A strong understanding of areas like Kubernetes, GPU clusters, inference platforms, or distributed systems.
Strategic Execution: A proven ability to shape GTM plans and positioning for highly technical platforms.
Communication: Outstanding writing and storytelling skills, capable of bringing together cross-functional collaborators and executives.
Adaptability: The ability to work proactively, navigate evolving projects, and thrive in a highly collaborative setting.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Specialized Insight: Deep familiarity with "AI Factory" infrastructure or cloud-native AI platforms.
Ecosystem Focus: Experience marketing software specifically for service providers or platform operators.
Community Mindset: Understanding of open-source models and ecosystem-led growth.
Learning Orientation: An MBA or an equivalent blend of business and technical growth.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 5, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 6.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 2, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Marketing & Communications

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Salesforce Marketing Cloud Product Marketing team shapes how customers understand our products, our portfolio, and the future of marketing. The Narrative & Platform team works across the portfolio to connect individual products and innovations into a clear, differentiated story and bring it to life across our most important customer and internal moments.

We are looking for an exceptional product marketer and storyteller to own portfolio messaging for Salesforce Marketing Cloud and bring that story to life across major launches, customer-facing keynotes, and internal kickoffs.

You will translate Marketing Cloud strategy and product innovation into clear, compelling stories across keynotes, executive presentations, customer content, and web. A significant part of the role is leading narrative development for flagship events such as Dreamforce, Connections, and World Tours, as well as internal kickoff events and our most important product launches.

This is a strategic and hands-on role for someone equally comfortable developing a messaging framework, shaping a keynote storyline, writing an executive script, or refining the final slide.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Lead Marketing Cloud portfolio messaging and storytelling. Develop a clear, differentiated story that connects our products, innovation, and customer value across executive and customer-facing content.
Support keynote and executive storytelling. Shape narratives for Dreamforce, Connections, World Tours, executive engagements, and major internal kickoff events, including presentation structure, scripting, demo integration, and speaker preparation.
Lead messaging for major product launches. Partner with product marketing and Product Management to connect priority innovations and announcements to the broader Marketing Cloud story and translate complex capabilities into clear customer value.
Drive high-impact storytelling across channels. Bring the portfolio narrative to life across First Call Decks, Strategic Innovation Conversations, web, and other priority content while leading cross-functional work across Product, Events, Creative, Communications, Sales, and executive stakeholders.

You're Our Person If...

8+ years of experience in product marketing, product strategy, or a related marketing role, ideally within enterprise technology or software.
Demonstrated experience developing positioning, messaging, and narratives for complex products or portfolios, and creating executive-level presentations, keynote content, or other high-visibility customer-facing storytelling.
Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional projects and partnering with senior stakeholders.
Ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed for major events and customer engagements, and to thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities can shift and timelines are often fixed.

Even Better If...

Experience marketing enterprise marketing technology, CRM, AI, customer data, or digital experience products.
Experience developing keynote or mainstage content for large customer, industry, or company events.
Experience supporting major product launches spanning multiple products, teams, or announcements.
Experience developing messaging for executive marketing audiences, including CMOs and other senior business leaders.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

jobs.title: Director, Marketing Manager – Digital Assets
jobs.description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We're committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

Pay And Benefits

Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
Pension / Retirement benefits
Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

The Marketing and Communications department at DTCC is responsible for shaping and promoting the company’s brand image, engaging target audiences, increasing client engagement and driving revenue opportunities across all channels, regions and market segments. Through outcome driven marketing campaigns, targeted digital engagement strategies, enterprise level event engagements, internal and external communications, media relations, and content creation, the department works to drive awareness, attract and retain customers or stakeholders, and support overall business goals.

Positioned alongside the Relationship Management and Growth teams within the Chief Client Office (CCO), the Marketing and Communications team is focused on providing consistent client experience across all channels and geographies, enabling enhanced client engagement, partner satisfaction, revenue growth and business success.

The Director of Marketing for Digital Assets will serve as the strategic and hands-on marketer responsible for developing and executing results-driven, cross-channel marketing strategies that align with business and growth objectives for DTCC’s Digital Assets business. Working in partnership with the Product and Client Relationship teams as well as the other Marcoms teams, this role guides the creation of integrated programs that build awareness, attract and engage target clients, and drive product adoption and revenue across the full marketing funnel. What’s more, this role will be responsible for coordinating speaking engagements and thought leadership opportunities, along with collaborating with the communications team on strategic press engagements and internal communications to elevate the presence of our executives and promote the client centric philosophy of DTCC.

Your Primary Responsibilities

Act as a true client partner, liaise/advise directly with stakeholders within the Digital Assets business and other key internal stakeholders to understand business goals and translate them into integrated and outcome driven marketing programs.
Understand market drivers and competitive landscape to continuously evolve marketing strategies and maintain a competitive edge.
Build client personas and segment focused engagement strategies in partnership with other client facing teams to align Marcoms plans to a more client centric mindset.
Develop and guide integrated multi-channel marketing programs (e.g. web, email, events, social, paid media, etc.), working directly with key business stakeholders, along with internal Marcoms teams and business partners to translate business goals into strategic, measurable, audience aligned marketing goals.
Lead client acquisition, expansion, and retention programs—partnering with client facing teams to drive segment-focused initiatives that deepen client relationships and contribute to revenue growth
Oversee the development of compelling content and thought leadership programs, by deeply understanding the needs of our clients, synthesizing key insights and partnering with the content and creative team to draft, refine, and finalize compelling pieces that align to strategic priorities and resonate with target audiences.
Work with event marketing to develop and execute proprietary client engagement opportunities across thought leadership, roundtable and hospitality engagements, along with managing participation at third party events
Engage with PR to facilitate media engagements and interviews for key executives to drive top tier coverage.
Collaborate with M&C channel leads (Events, Social, Web etc.) and discipline teams (design, content, video etc.) to ensure marcoms plans are implemented effectively across all platforms, with consistent measurement and optimization practices.
Partner with regional marketing counterparts to provide direction on client engagement and demand generation initiatives by region
Lean into AI and Technology advancements across the Marcoms stack to drive efficiency, creativity and greater performance of audience-based Marcoms campaigns.
Leverage data and analytics to track program, content and channel performance to identify opportunities for improvement and communicate impact to stakeholders

**NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above. **

Qualifications

Minimum of 8 years of related experience - general B2B marketing / communications / thought leadership and demand generation experience / background in preferably in financial services, fintech, crypto or B2B infrastructure sectors.
Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, or related field; MBA preferred.
Experience with Marketo preferred, or other marketing automation platforms.

Talents Needed For Success

Strong understanding of financial services and broader financial ecosystem, with experience developing marketing and communications strategies in a complex, regulated environment.
Strategic Orientation: Approach is strategic and critical thinking oriented. Challenges constructively and drive end-to-end problem solving. Brings an innovative approach to business opportunities, foreseeing problems before they arise, and challenging complacency and the way things have always been done. The ability to create long-term strategies and plans, which reflect a thorough understanding of how the business operates.
Collaborative Mindset: Effectively communicates a compelling picture of how team goals ladder up to both departmental and organizational priorities. Exceptional ability to build relationships with key stakeholders, both within the Marketing and Communications department and throughout the organization through a strong level of presence, EQ and interpersonal skills.
Hands-On Operator: A leader who "rolls up their sleeves" and is not afraid to "lean-in" to a problem and get involved when the situation requires attention. Leads from the front with energy, drive and a pragmatic, engaged approach to day-to-day execution. Strong detail orientation. Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative culture.
Drive for Results: Ensures things are getting done at an appropriate pace, impacting business performance at the highest levels. Evoking ownership and accountability, streamlining processes and structure, leveraging technology to drive efficiencies and reallocating resources quickly and flexibly.

The salary range is indicative for roles at the same level within DTCC across all US locations. Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

jobs.title: Marketing & Events Manager
jobs.description:
About MassMedia

MassMedia is a women-owned, integrated marketing and public relations agency with offices in Las Vegas, Orange County, California and Phoenix. For nearly 30 years, we've helped ambitious brands grow through strategic marketing, creative thinking, compelling storytelling and measurable business results.

As we continue expanding throughout the Western United States, we're looking for a talented, resourceful and highly organized Marketing & Events Manager to lead our internal marketing initiatives, elevate our brand presence and create meaningful opportunities to connect with clients, prospects and industry leaders.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a hands-on marketing professional who knows how to turn strategy into action.

This role will oversee MassMedia's internal marketing programs, brand communications, content initiatives, industry events, sponsorships and marketing campaigns. A significant part of the position will involve planning and executing events.

The ideal candidate is a creative thinker, exceptional organizer and natural relationship builder who thrives on bringing people, ideas and experiences together.

You'll work closely with agency leadership, internal teams and external partners to strengthen MassMedia's brand, support new business development and deliver exceptional events and marketing programs.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Brand Management

Execute MassMedia's annual marketing plan, supporting brand awareness, thought leadership and new business growth
Manage integrated marketing campaigns across email, social media, content, PR, events and other channels
Ensure consistent brand messaging, positioning and visual identity across all agency marketing initiatives
Coordinate marketing materials, agency credentials, presentations, case studies and promotional collateral
Support marketing initiatives for our industry practice groups and expansion into new markets
Identify strategic partnerships, sponsorships and promotional opportunities that elevate MassMedia's visibility

Event Planning & Management

Serve as the primary owner of MassMedia's events and experiential marketing initiatives, from concept through post-event evaluation.

Plan, manage and execute all MassMedia-hosted events
Develop event concepts, themes, programming, timelines and budgets
Coordinate speakers, panelists, moderators, sponsors, vendors and event partners
Manage venue logistics, catering, audiovisual production, invitations, registration, signage and event materials
Oversee event marketing and promotional campaigns to drive attendance and engagement
Manage event sponsorship fulfillment and partner communications
Coordinate on-site setup, event staffing, guest experience and execution
Develop post-event communications, recaps, follow-up campaigns and performance reports
Evaluate event success based on attendance, engagement, relationship development and business opportunities

Content Marketing & Communications

Manage MassMedia's editorial calendar, coordinating blogs, newsletters, case studies and thought leadership content
Work with agency leaders and subject matter experts to develop relevant, engaging content
Oversee quarterly agency newsletters and other email communications
Coordinate internal social media content planning and approvals
Partner with the PR team to identify opportunities to promote MassMedia's expertise, leadership and agency news
Maintain and update website content in coordination with internal and external technical resources

New Business & Practice Group Marketing

Collaborate with agency leadership to develop marketing initiatives that support business development
Coordinate targeted campaigns, prospect engagement initiatives and industry-specific marketing programs
Support MassMedia's practice groups with content, events, partnerships and promotional activities
Identify relevant conferences, industry associations, networking opportunities and sponsorships
Help create compelling marketing materials and outreach campaigns for prospective clients
Track marketing activities and help evaluate their contribution to lead generation and business growth

Marketing Operations & Vendor Coordination

Manage marketing calendars, project timelines, budgets and deliverables
Coordinate external marketing specialists, including freelance CRM and marketing automation support
Work with technical partners to execute email campaigns, manage contact lists, maintain registration systems and support lead tracking
Coordinate with website developers and other vendors as needed
Monitor marketing performance and prepare regular updates for agency leadership
Maintain marketing project plans and workflows in Monday.com

The Ideal Candidate

You're a marketer who loves making things happen.

You enjoy building campaigns, creating memorable experiences, bringing people together and seeing projects through from beginning to end.

You're comfortable developing a marketing plan in the morning, coordinating with a speaker or sponsor in the afternoon, and overseeing an event that evening.

You bring creativity, professionalism, strong judgment and exceptional follow-through to everything you do.

Most importantly, you understand that great marketing should build relationships, strengthen brands and ultimately drive business growth.

Why MassMedia?

At MassMedia, you'll be part of an entrepreneurial, collaborative and ambitious agency with a strong reputation and exciting plans for continued growth.

You'll have the opportunity to shape our agency's marketing, build meaningful industry relationships and lead signature events that bring together some of the region's most influential marketing and business leaders.

Requirements

3+ years of experience in marketing, event management, brand marketing or integrated marketing communications
Demonstrated experience independently planning and executing professional, corporate or industry events
Strong understanding of traditional and digital marketing channels
Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and stakeholders
Exceptional writing, communication and interpersonal skills
Experience coordinating vendors, sponsors, agencies or external partners
Strong attention to detail and ability to manage event budgets and logistics
Ability to work collaboratively with senior leadership and cross-functional teams
A proactive, resourceful and solutions-oriented approach

Benefits

At MassMedia, we pride ourselves on hiring top talent and we work hard to provide benefits that make our team members lives better.

Our comprehensive compensations and benefits program includes:

Airport office location that is centrally located for an easy commute and comes with great amenities and perks
Competitive salaries and opportunity for advancement; we always strive to promote from within!
Medical, dental and visions plans for you and your family
401(k) plan with company matching program
Generous paid time off policy that increases each year you are with the company
11 paid holidays and we pay you to take your birthday off!
Frequent company happy hours, events and team building activities
Professional development opportunities

jobs.title: Paid Search Growth Marketing Manager - US
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About The Role

North America is one of our priority markets. With Spend launching in the US, paid search is a core demand-capture channel, and we're hiring a Paid Search Growth Marketing Manager to run it day to day. You'll own the execution of paid search across Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising in North America, working to the strategy set by the Senior Manager, Paid Marketing, and driving a consistent pipeline of high-quality B2B leads for Sales. You'll also help shape how Perk shows up in AI answer engines, partnering with our SEO team on AEO. This is a hands-on role for someone who is strong on data, curious about AI, and comfortable working across Marketing and Sales.

What You'll Do:

Campaign management and optimization

Manage Perk's paid search campaigns across Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising in North America, owning bid management, budget pacing and campaign optimisation.
Run regular search query analysis, keyword expansion and negative keyword management to keep the account efficient and clean.
Use data-driven optimization to iterate continuously on efficiency and results across key metrics, from in-platform performance to online and offline conversions.

Testing and analysis

Create, monitor and analyse A/B tests on ad copy and landing pages.
Run competitor and industry analysis to find opportunities to improve campaigns.
Report to management and key stakeholders with regular performance updates and monthly reporting.

AEO and AI search

Partner with the SEO team on AEO (Answer Engine optimization) initiatives, so that Perk is found and cited by AI answer engines for the travel and spend topics that matter to our buyers.
Use paid search data (converting queries, competitor terms, landing page performance) to inform AEO priorities and content.
Test and report on how AI-driven search features, including AI Overviews and Google's AI Max, change performance and user behavior.
Embrace AI tools in your day-to-day workflow, from ad copy and keyword research to performance analysis, and help the team adopt new ways of working as our AI capabilities evolve.

Working across teams

Work with North America Field Marketing and SDR teams to improve lead quality and close the gap between Marketing and Sales.
Collaborate with global Paid Media, Brand and Creative teams so paid search connects to the wider customer journey.
Maintain strong relationships with platform partner reps (Google, Microsoft) to stay ahead of new features and betas.

What We're Looking For

Paid search expertise

4+ years of hands-on experience managing paid search campaigns, in-house or at a digital agency.
Excellent working knowledge of Google Ads, including Search, Performance Max and Remarketing.
Proficient use of Google Ads Editor and/or Microsoft Advertising Editor.
Experience managing B2B lead generation campaigns at scale.
Strong understanding of SQR analysis, keyword optimisation, match types and bidding strategies.
Proven track record of delivering (or overachieving) against growth targets and quarterly OKRs.
Experience with conversion tracking, tag management (e.g. Google Tag Manager) and attribution.
Analytical proficiency: comfortable in Google Analytics, Looker or similar tools, and skilled in MS Excel / Google Sheets.

Skills And Traits

Analytical mindset: you turn campaign data into clear actions and learnings and share them with the wider team.
Strategic yet hands-on: you move between high-level planning and day-to-day execution.
Test-and-learn approach: curious and iterative, and not afraid to shut down what isn't working.
Great communicator: you explain your decisions and reasoning clearly across teams.
Highly organised: you bring discipline to budget management, account hygiene and campaign structure.
Up to date: you stay ahead of platform updates, new ad features and industry trends.
Team player: collaborative and cross-functional by nature.
AI-curious: open to experimenting with AI tools and helping shape how the team works as they mature.

Bonus points for

Not required, but will strengthen a candidate's application:

Experience with AEO and an understanding of how AI answer engines find and cite sources.
Basic knowledge of SEO and how it relates to paid search strategy.
Previous experience at a B2B SaaS company or high-growth startup.
Experience in Travel, FinTech or expense management.
Experience designing full-funnel B2B campaigns that connect brand awareness to demand generation and pipeline.
Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation tools such as Salesforce or Marketo.

What We Offer

Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk
Rest and recharge with our generous allocation of 20 vacation days and 12 public holidays
Enjoy the flexibility of three medical plans to choose from, with company contributions and an HSA when enrolling in an HDHP medical plan
Take control of your physical health with additional comprehensive benefit plans, covering dental, vision and Wellhub’s gym subscription from your start date
Rest assured that you’re covered by life and disability policies from your start date, with options to add extra protection through voluntary buy-up plans
Plan for your future with our 401(k) plan with company matching contributions
Care for your furry friends through partner discounts on pet insurance
Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party
Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones
Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave
Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes
Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year
Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years
Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

Compensation

Compensation for this role is a combination of salary and stock options. The anticipated base salary range is $93,500 - $110,000 per year. Actual compensation may vary based on specific qualifications, experience, and other job-related factors.

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams
