new_jobs.description:
SmartBug Media is one of the most respected names in the HubSpot ecosystem — and we've earned it.

We didn't get here by accident. SmartBug has built a reputation that most agencies only aspire to: HubSpot North American Partner of the Year, a fully remote team of specialists who punch well above their weight, and a client base that doesn't just hire us — they stay with us. That last part is the one we're most proud of.

Remote by design and strategic by nature, we've never believed that great work requires a corner office or a campus cafeteria. What it requires is the right people, deeply aligned on outcomes, working with clients who trust them to deliver. That's the culture we've built — one where expertise travels, relationships run deep, and the work speaks for itself.

We're obsessed with client outcomes. Not vanity metrics. Not feel-good reports. Real, measurable growth that makes our clients look like heroes inside their own organizations. When SmartBug is in your corner, your team wins — and that's exactly why our clients keep coming back.

We're growing, our client portfolio is expanding, and the relationships we've built are stronger than ever. What we need next is a leader who understands that the hardest part of this business isn't winning clients — it's becoming so embedded in their success that leaving simply isn't an option. If you've built that kind of loyalty before, if you know what it takes to transform a good client relationship into a decade-long partnership, and if you're energized by the idea of architecting that function at scale — we want to meet you.

About The Role

The Director, Strategy is a high-impact business consultant responsible for defining the overarching vision

and multi-service roadmap for SmartBug's medium and large accounts. While Marketing Strategy remains

the primary engine of growth and the core of the client's strategic focus, this role brings the business

acumen to factor in cross-functional approaches—such as AI, Web, PR, and technical integrations—to

create a unified competitive advantage.

As the final touchpoint for strategic deliverables, the Director ensures that every plan is sophisticated,

integrated, and aligned with the client's long-term business objectives. The Director provides high-level

vision and relies on a team of Strategists and Specialists to handle day-to-day execution.

The Director, Strategy Will Be Measured On

Strategic Excellence: Quality and innovation of the overall marketing and business roadmap.
Sales Impact: Contribution to closing and correctly scoping large and medium accounts.
Client Satisfaction: Long-term results, ROI attainment, and executive-level trust, including the

ability to communicate with C-level executives on client accounts.

Pod Performance: Success and professional development of the team members in the pod.

What You'll Do

Integrated Marketing & Business Strategy

Marketing-Led Vision: Act as the primary architect of the client's marketing engine, ensuring demand generation, brand positioning, and content strategy are the core drivers of ROI.
Cross-Functional Synthesis: Evaluate how non-marketing business functions (e.g., AI automation, technical API integrations, and PR-led authority) can be leveraged to amplify the core marketing strategy.
Full-Lifecycle Alignment: Ensure the marketing strategy seamlessly transitions into sales enablement and customer success, creating a closed-loop system that factors in the entire business operation.
Service Ecosystem Orchestration: Move beyond "HubSpot-only" thinking to determine when a client requires specialized services like web development or advanced data integrations to remove friction from the marketing funnel.

Strategic Governance & Vision

Quarterly Steering: Lead high-impact strategic sessions with client executives to pivot the vision based on market trends, ensuring marketing efforts remain agile and business-relevant.
Final Strategic Touchpoint: Review and refine all major strategic deliverables to ensure they reflect a holistic business perspective before they reach the client.
Strategic ROI Benchmarking: Define how marketing KPIs translate into broader business outcomes like Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) and overall revenue growth.

Sales Growth & Collaboration

Strategic Scoping: Partner with the Sales team to identify gaps where a client's core marketing goals could be better supported by PR, AI, or technical services, ensuring the initial scope is comprehensive.
Vision Selling: Assist sales reps by articulating the "Total SmartBug Advantage," showing prospects how marketing strategy acts as the foundation for a wider business transformation.

Senior Director, Product Marketing & Applications, Data Center Power Delivery

The Opportunity

We are seeking a proven technical and strategic Senior Director to lead the global Product Marketing and Applications Engineering organization for Data Center Power Delivery. This dual-function leader will connect market insight, semiconductor and system-level power expertise, product strategy, and customer execution to accelerate profitable growth.

You will define and scale differentiated 48 V/54 V-to-core solutions for next-generation AI data centers, advancing power density, efficiency, integration, and system architecture to help unlock AI at scale and its potential to transform industries and improve lives worldwide.

You will own the product, market, and go-to-market roadmap for the portfolio, working in close alignment with R&D and design leadership to translate hyperscaler needs into winning silicon solutions and measurable business results.

Role at a Glance

Reports To: Head of Data Center Power Delivery.
Organization: Lead the global Product Marketing and Applications Engineering organization for Data Center Power Delivery.
Markets: AI accelerators, high-density servers, cloud infrastructure, networking, and high-performance computing.
Portfolio: High-current point-of-load solutions, 48 V/54 V intermediate bus converters, power modules, smart power stages, and system management solutions.
Technology: Advanced packaging and magnetics, high-frequency conversion, vertical power delivery, and thermal-mechanical co-design.

What You Will Own

Portfolio Strategy & Business Performance

Market & Roadmap Strategy: Convert customer, application, and competitive insight into a differentiated multi-year product and technology roadmap aligned with R&D leadership.
Product Definition, Pathfinding & Investment: Translate market needs into product requirements and business cases; evaluate emerging architectures, packaging, magnetics, silicon technologies, partnerships, and inorganic opportunities; and influence investment, sequencing, and build/buy/partner decisions.
Portfolio Performance: Drive positioning, segmentation, pricing, lifecycle, capacity, and cost decisions to grow revenue, market share, margin, and return on investment.

Applications & Solution Execution

System Architecture & Requirements: Partner with customers and R&D to translate performance, density, efficiency, thermal, reliability, telemetry, and cost needs into system architectures and clear product requirements.
Product & Application Readiness: Guide design trade-offs and ensure validation, evaluation platforms, reference designs, models, tools, documentation, and qualification support are ready for customer adoption.
Customer Execution & Learning: Lead strategic evaluations, integration, debugging, and critical issue resolution; feed field learning into product improvements and future roadmaps.

Go-to-Market & Design Wins

Launch & Operational Readiness: Align product performance, quality, evaluation tools, documentation, supply, capacity, communications, and support for on-time launches and production ramps.
Design-Win Conversion: Equip sales and field teams, prioritize strategic opportunities, and convert evaluations and reference-platform inclusion into production revenue.

Customer & Ecosystem Leadership

Strategic Relationships: Build trusted relationships with hyperscalers, partners, and internal stakeholders across engineering, architecture, procurement, and business leadership.
Platform Influence: Anticipate requirements, shape next-generation platforms, and focus applications and marketing resources on the highest-value opportunities and risks.
Ecosystem & Executive Engagement: Lead senior customer and partner reviews; support agreements, licensing, joint development, and strategic collaborations.

Organization & Talent Leadership

Organization Leadership: Lead and develop a global team of Product Applications Managers, Product Marketing Managers, Application Engineers, and technical leaders.

Growth & Profitability: Year-over-year revenue growth, market-share gain, gross-margin expansion, forecast accuracy, and return on development investment.

Required

Education: BS or higher in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
Leadership Experience: 15+ years in power management, semiconductor applications, product management, product definition, or technical product marketing, including global leadership of managers and senior technical talent.
Power Architecture Expertise: Deep knowledge of high-current, high-density conversion for data center, AI accelerator, server, or networking systems, including xPU core power, smart power stages, point-of-load converters, modules, and intermediate-bus solutions.

Summary

The Marketing Operations Program Specialist, working in collaboration with and in support of the firm’s strategic initiatives, is a versatile member of the Marketing Business Development (MBD) team, responsible for supporting a broad range of marketing operations projects while also serving as the team's internal resource for identifying and advancing practical AI opportunities.

This role is equal parts doer and coordinator — stepping in on high-priority initiatives, managing ad hoc project requests, and ensuring cross-functional work stays on track. Alongside that operational foundation, the Specialist brings working knowledge of AI tools and a curiosity for how they can be applied to improve MBD's everyday workflows, reporting, and content processes.

Critically, this is a business-side role. The Specialist does not own AI infrastructure, build technical systems, or operate independently of the firm's IT and Innovation functions. Instead, they serve as MBD's informed liaison — identifying opportunities, scoping use cases, supporting pilots in partnership with the appropriate technical teams, and ensuring successful adoption across the MBD team.

Act as a reliable operational resource during periods of high demand, stepping in to manage workstreams, track deliverables, and keep projects moving.
Coordinate across MBD sub-teams to maintain alignment on shared priorities, dependencies, and timelines.
Develop and maintain project documentation, status reports, and process guides to support consistency and institutional knowledge.

Program Coordination & Governance

Support the design and upkeep of program governance structures across MBD's project portfolio, including intake processes, prioritization frameworks, and escalation paths.

Help leadership assess competing priorities and resource constraints, recommending sequencing and trade-offs using structured frameworks.

Facilitate working sessions and informal coaching to build team confidence and consistency in using approved AI tools.
Curate and share best practices, prompt libraries, and usage guidance to enable compliant and effective AI use across teams with varying levels of familiarity.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Facilitate collaboration across distributed teams with different priorities and working styles, creating alignment and momentum on shared work.

The ideal candidate brings 6+ years of experience in project management, program coordination, or marketing operations, with a proven track record of driving accountability across complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives. They consistently prioritize competing requests using structured frameworks (e.g., impact/effort, urgency, risk, and dependencies) and communicate clear trade-offs to stakeholders.

They have strong working knowledge of AI tools and technologies, including generative AI platforms, automation tools, and data analytics solutions.

Strong communication and facilitation skills are essential, as this role requires consistent alignment across teams with different priorities and working styles. Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and the enterprise AI landscape is a plus, as is experience within a business development or marketing organization. Candidates with a background in change management, business transformation, or agile delivery methodologies will be well-positioned to succeed in this role.

Effectively communicate, verbally and in writing, with clients, lawyers, business professionals, and third parties.
Produce deliverables, answer phone calls, and reply to correspondence in an efficient and responsive manner.

Type One Energy Group is mission-driven to provide sustainable, affordable fusion power to the world. This role offers hands-on experience in storytelling, internal communications, and content creation for both internal and external audiences. You’ll help craft engaging messages that connect our employees, celebrate our company culture, and share our mission with the world.

As part of the Marketing and Communications team, you’ll support projects across employee communications, social media, website content, and event coordination. This is a great opportunity for someone passionate about writing, storytelling, and communicating science and technology in accessible and inspiring ways.

Content creation: Develop and curate engaging content for newsletters, intranet updates, announcements, and internal campaigns.

On-site assistance: Provide hands-on help during events — from registration and scheduling to ensuring a positive attendee experience.

Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree program in marketing, communications, journalism, or a related field.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to create compelling, audience-appropriate content.
Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Teams).
Familiarity with social media platforms (LinkedIn, X/Twitter, Instagram, etc.) and digital content tools.

new_jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Growth Marketing
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

The real world is the next frontier, and at Metropolis, we are creating the artificial intelligence to make it responsive. We are pioneering the Recognition Economy — a future where mundane repetition disappears and being known unlocks access, comfort and belonging everywhere you go. From transforming parking into a seamless drive-in, drive-out experience for millions of Members to expanding our intelligence layer across retail and hospitality, we are building a world that feels instinctive and magical. The future isn’t coming; it’s here, and we need builders, innovators and problem solvers to help us create it.

Who You Are

Metropolis is seeking a Senior Data Scientist, Growth Marketing to join our growing data team. In this role, you will serve as the primary quantitative partner to our Growth Marketing leadership, turning massive real-world transactional and behavioral datasets into engines for user acquisition, retention, and gross profit expansion. You bring a deep background in marketing measurement and causal inference, with proven experience building multi-touch attribution systems, modeling customer lifetime value (LTV), and designing rigorous marketing experiments. You excel not only at building complex predictive models, but also at translating high-level data insights into clear business strategies for cross-functional stakeholders across Growth, Product, and Finance.

What You'll Do

Design, deploy, and refine predictive models for Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), Customer Lifetime Value (CLV), and Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) efficiency to guide multi-channel marketing budget allocation
Conduct deep-dive cohort analyses and retention modeling to uncover drivers of user conversion, repeat behavior, and churn across our location-based growth funnel
Lead the growth experimentation roadmap by designing, executing, and analyzing A/B tests, geo-experiments, holdout tests, and incrementality studies across digital and physical acquisition channels
Partner directly with Growth Marketing and Finance leaders to optimize unit economics, justify marketing spend against gross profit targets, and set channel-level growth goals
Collaborate with analytics and data engineering teams to establish event tracking requirements, build scalable growth data pipelines, and develop automated executive dashboards
Utilize advanced AI tools and modern analytics frameworks to transform static analytical workflows into responsive, high-output processes

What we're looking for

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field
6+ years of proven experience as a Data Scientist or Analytics Lead, with a distinct focus on growth marketing, performance media, or adtech
Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL for complex data manipulation, statistical modeling, and predictive analytics
Deep domain expertise in growth measurement frameworks, multi-touch attribution, cohort retention modeling, and LTV/CAC dynamics
Hands-on experience with statistical experimentation and causal inference techniques such as A/B testing, geo-testing, synthetic controls, and media mix modeling
Strong business acumen with a track record of partnering with senior executives in Growth, Product, and Finance to drive measurable bottom-line growth
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills to make complex data stories intuitive and actionable
Experience leveraging AI tools to transform static workflows into responsive, high-output processes

While not required, these are a plus:

Experience with cloud platforms, including AWS S3, SageMaker, and Airflow
Experience with cloud data warehouses and modern data tools such as Snowflake, dbt, Looker, and Tableau
Familiarity with Media Mix Modeling (MMM) frameworks including Robyn and LightweightMMM
Hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch applied to user segmentation or churn prediction
Ability to write clean, efficient, robust, and well-commented code to produce high-quality data science procedures

4 Days in Office:
Metropolis values in-person collaboration to drive innovation, strengthen culture, and enhance the Member experience. Our corporate team members hold to our office-first model, which requires employees to be on-site at least four days a week, fostering organic interactions that spark creativity and connection.

When you join Metropolis, you’ll join a team of world-class product leaders and engineers, building an ecosystem of technologies at the intersection of parking, mobility, and real estate. Our goal is to build an inclusive culture where everyone has a voice and the best idea wins. You will play a key role in building and maintaining this culture as our organization grows. The anticipated base salary for this position is $170,000 USD to $200,000 USD annually. The actual base pay offered is determined by a number of variables, including, as appropriate, the applicant's qualifications for the position, years of relevant experience, distinctive skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location of residence and/or place of employment. Base pay is one component of Metropolis’s total compensation package, which usually includes: healthcare benefits, a 401(k) plan, short-term and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, a lucrative stock option plan, bonus plans, and more.

Metropolis may utilize an automated employment decision tool (AEDT) to assess or evaluate your candidacy for employment or promotion. AEDTs are used to assist in assessing a candidate’s application relative to the required job qualifications and responsibilities listed in the job posting.

As part of this process, Metropolis retains data relevant to your candidacy, including personal information, for a period that is reasonably necessary for the use of the tool. If you are hired for the position, your data may become part of your employee records.

Metropolis Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs — without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation, and pregnancy), national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under federal, state, or local law.

We are committed to providing a welcoming, accessible hiring experience. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please reach out to us at recruiting@metropolis.io.

new_jobs.title: Sr Marketing Manager, Amazon
new_jobs.description:
About Us

Who we are:

Samsonite is the worldwide leader in superior travel bags, luggage, and accessories combining notable style with the latest design technology and the utmost attention to quality and durability. For more than 100 years, Samsonite has leveraged its rich heritage to create unparalleled products that fulfill the travel lifestyle needs of conscious movers everywhere. With a portfolio of brands including Samsonite, Tumi, American Tourister, High Sierra, Gregory, Hartmann, and Lipault Paris, our products are sold in over 100 countries in North America, Asia, Europe and Latin America through our company-operated retail store, websites and a variety of retail partners.

Job Description

The Sr Marketing Manager, Amazon is responsible for driving sell-through, share growth, and account marketing strategy for the Amazon channel across the portfolio of brands. This role is accountable for traffic, conversion, and share growth.

This role operates as the primary marketing leader for Amazon, orchestrating cross-functional resources from Growth & Demand (media), Digital Shelf & CRM (shelf standards), Brand CoE (brand briefs), and IHA/Content CoE (assets) to execute against omnichannel standards. This role partners closely with Product Marketing and Sales to define the Amazon account strategy, build the account marketing calendar, and lead all account-facing marketing execution — leveraging CoE experts as needed for sell-in.

This is a hybrid role; we work on site 4 days and remotely 1 day, weekly.

Essential Functions

Serve as the primary marketing lead for the Amazon channel — account-facing across the retailer and internally across the RMEO organization.
Develop and own the Amazon account marketing strategy in partnership with Product Marketing, CoEs and Sales
Build the Amazon marketing calendar to maximize channel potential across seasons, launches, and key moments
Drive Amazon sell-through, ROAS, and share growth by brand across the Amazon channel
Partner with the CoEs to ensure Amazon account success while adhering to omnichannel standards and guidelines
Coordinate cross-functionalresources from Growth & Demand , Digital Shelf & CRM (PDP standards), Brand CoE (briefs), and IHA/Content (assets)
Own Amazon retailer relationship in regards to marketing— including Amazon Ads reps, Amazon Retail team, and agency partners
Lead A+ content, brand store, and PDP execution in partnership with IHA and Digital Shelf & CRM — briefing content against Amazon spec
Manage Amazon search rank, sponsored placement, and organic ranking strategy in partnership with Growth & Demand
Own Amazon algorithm intelligence — search terms, competitive positioning, and organic performance drivers
Monitor, analyze, and report on Amazon channel performance including sell-through, ROAS, share of search, review velocity, and availability
Lead ROI analysis, campaign tracking, and competitive analysis to inform future Amazon investment decisions
Partner with Merchandising and Sales on Amazon promotional calendar and joint business planning
Escalate media investment needs and shelf issues to the appropriate CoE — pod lead coordinates, does not own headcount
Report Amazon channel KPIs (sell-through, ROAS, search rank, availability) to RMEO Lead
Support set up of new skus for 3P partners

KPIs OWNED

Amazon sell-through
Amazon share of search / share of shelf
Retailer search rank
Pod-level ROAS
Review velocity
Availability rate

Minimum Requirements

7+ years of Amazon marketplace, ecommerce, or retail media experience
Proven track record developing and executing Amazon growth strategies including Sponsored Ads and DSP
Strong understanding of Amazon algorithm, search dynamics, and PDP conversion drivers
Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills with fluency in Amazon reporting tools
Experience managing agency partners and cross-functional stakeholders
Strong problem-solving and communication skills with the ability to educate and influence others in the organization

Preferred Skills

Amazon Vendor Central and/or Seller Central experience
Experience with retail media planning and unified investment frameworks
You have an account owner mindset — you treat Amazon like your own business, not just a marketing channel
You are analytical, data-driven, and use performance data to drive decisions
You have excellent attention to detail, follow-through, and a strong sense of urgency for deadlines
You are a resourceful go-getter who thrives in a matrixed environment
You partner effectively with brand, creative, digital shelf, and sales teams
Understanding of A+ content, brand stores, and Amazon-specific content-to-commerce best practices

Other Requirements

Domestic travel: 10%
International travel: 0%

About The Team

Why you'll love working here:

Our employees matter. As a people-focused business, we work hard to provide meaningful rewards and development opportunities for our employees, recognizing performance, and creating a supportive working environment for them, wherever they are based.
Vibrant culture. We are committed to a diverse and rich culture, welcoming people from all walks of life. Our long-standing commitment to culture and inclusion empowers us to bring our authentic selves and unique differences to work every day.
Socially responsible. We want to minimize our products' impact on the environment and help create positive journeys worldwide. We do this by creating the best products using the most sustainable and innovative materials, methods, and models.

What We Value

At Samsonite, we do more than create the bags that move with our consumer, we inspire and celebrate the moments that move them. We believe we have a responsibility to the world in how we operate, the products we sell, the communities where we live and work, and how we treat the people we employ. We're as diverse as travel itself, and like travel, your journey with Samsonite presents the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and explore your passions. This is why we offer various paths for professionals and celebrate the knowledge and skills they bring to our team. We are committed to a respectful workplace that allows our team members to bring their best selves to the workplace daily.

Samsonite is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting and maintaining a work environment in which all applicants, associates, customers, and other individuals are treated with dignity and respect free from unlawful harassment, discrimination, or retaliation.

·      5–8 years of relevant experience, including demonstrated ownership of integrated social media, digital or paid media campaigns and experience managing agency partners and complex cross-functional workstreams.
·      Working knowledge of paid, owned, earned and retail media channels.
·      Strong project management, communication, presentation and analytical skills.
·      Ability to develop recommendations, influence without direct authority and operate effectively in ambiguity.
·      Consumer packaged goods, food and beverage or premium consumer brand experience.
·      Experience with creators, content production, experiential programs, sampling and retail media.
·      Experience connecting marketing activity to customer plans, conversion and sales results.
·      Brand management, innovation, commercialization or new-product launch experience.
·      Familiarity with forecasting, budget management and performance measurement.
·      Experience working with global or international brand teams.
Measures of Success ·      Clear, integrated social and omnichannel plans with defined roles across channels, partners and internal owners.

Data Science & Programming:

Comfortable working with ambiguity, proactively identifying business opportunities, reviewing and validating analytical work produced by others or AI tools, and maintaining accountability for accuracy and business impact.

new_jobs.title: Director of Search Marketing (Remote, Raleigh)
new_jobs.description:
Blacksmith Agency

Marketing
Full time
Remote (USA, Canada or South Africa)

About The Role

Blacksmith Agency runs PPC and SEO for clients across multifamily, B2B and technical verticals. As Director of Search Marketing you lead that department. The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist report to you and they are the specialists in their channels. Right now nobody owns this function, which is the whole reason this seat is open.

This is a management seat, not a senior individual contributor one.
You will not be building campaigns, and on technical SEO your strategist will know more than you do. That is the arrangement, not a gap. You carry channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale. The strategists carry the execution of it, and you carry whether the department delivers.

What You Own

The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist: their quality bar, their development, their reviews, and the call when someone is not going to get there.
The standard the work is held to. What a good audit looks like, what gets checked before work leaves the agency, how an account is reported. You write it and you hold two specialists to it.
Client results across the whole function, including whether our reporting is honest. Nobody here is auditing attribution and GA4 accuracy today.
The escalation when an account is at risk. You diagnose it, you direct the strategist who fixes it, and you are on the call with the client.
Channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale.
What we tell sales we can credibly deliver, before it gets sold.
The hiring plan for the department, and first-round interviews for your own team, within about a quarter.

What You Need

Strategists or specialists who have reported to you, where their reviews, their development and the decision when someone was not working out were yours. Managing accounts is not this.
7+ years across paid media and SEO. Owning one channel while sitting beside the other does not count here.
Enough depth in Google Ads, GA4, Search Console, Meta and Microsoft Ads to tell good work from work that merely looks good. That is a lower bar than doing it and a higher bar than reading a report.
One account you turned around that you can talk through: the metric, the figure before, the figure after, and why the change worked. Whose hands were on the keyboard matters far less than whether the diagnosis was yours.
Comfortable being the client-facing owner when an account is underperforming. That call comes to you, not to the strategist.
Agency experience carrying many accounts at once.

Please do not apply if

Nobody has ever reported to you, or you have never owned someone's review or had to performance-manage anyone.
You have only ever run one channel.
All of your experience is in-house on a single brand.
What you actually want is to keep building campaigns yourself. That is not a lesser ambition, it is a different job, and this is not it.

None of these are preferences we bend on. They are how we screen, so applying anyway costs you an hour and gets you a no.

Process

Three conversations, then a decision. A thirty minute screen with our recruiter, a first round with the founder this seat reports to, and a final. No take-home project and no panel interview.

How To Apply

Four fields at the link, then a short 6 minute Predictive Index assessment. Use the same email throughout. No cover letter.

About The Role

Blacksmith Agency runs PPC and SEO for clients across multifamily, B2B and technical verticals. As Director of Performance Marketing you lead that department. The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist report to you and they are the specialists in their channels. Right now nobody owns this function, which is the whole reason this seat is open.

This is a management seat, not a senior individual contributor one.
You will not be building campaigns, and on technical SEO your strategist will know more than you do. That is the arrangement, not a gap. You carry channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale. The strategists carry the execution of it, and you carry whether the department delivers.

What You Own

The PPC strategist and the SEO strategist: their quality bar, their development, their reviews, and the call when someone is not going to get there.
The standard the work is held to. What a good audit looks like, what gets checked before work leaves the agency, how an account is reported. You write it and you hold two specialists to it.
Client results across the whole function, including whether our reporting is honest. Nobody here is auditing attribution and GA4 accuracy today.
The escalation when an account is at risk. You diagnose it, you direct the strategist who fixes it, and you are on the call with the client.
Channel strategy and where budget goes as accounts scale.
What we tell sales we can credibly deliver, before it gets sold.
The hiring plan for the department, and first-round interviews for your own team, within about a quarter.

What You Need

Strategists or specialists who have reported to you, where their reviews, their development and the decision when someone was not working out were yours. Managing accounts is not this.
7+ years across paid media and SEO. Owning one channel while sitting beside the other does not count here.
Enough depth in Google Ads, GA4, Search Console, Meta and Microsoft Ads to tell good work from work that merely looks good. That is a lower bar than doing it and a higher bar than reading a report.
One account you turned around that you can talk through: the metric, the figure before, the figure after, and why the change worked. Whose hands were on the keyboard matters far less than whether the diagnosis was yours.
Comfortable being the client-facing owner when an account is underperforming. That call comes to you, not to the strategist.
Agency experience carrying many accounts at once.

Please do not apply if

Nobody has ever reported to you, or you have never owned someone's review or had to performance-manage anyone.
You have only ever run one channel.
All of your experience is in-house on a single brand.
What you actually want is to keep building campaigns yourself. That is not a lesser ambition, it is a different job, and this is not it.

None of these are preferences we bend on. They are how we screen, so applying anyway costs you an hour and gets you a no.

Process

Three conversations, then a decision. A thirty minute screen with our recruiter, a first round with the founder this seat reports to, and a final. No take-home project and no panel interview.

How To Apply

Four fields at the link, then a short 6 minute Predictive Index assessment. Use the same email throughout. No cover letter.

Role Overview

Fashion Nova is seeking a Social Media Manager to lead day-to-day social strategy, creative development, and channel execution across the brand’s social platforms.

Reporting to the Director of Social Media, this role will manage a team of four Social Media Specialists and play a key role in translating Fashion Nova’s broader social strategy into distinctive, culturally relevant content and campaigns.

We are looking for someone who thinks beyond the content calendar. This person should have a strong creative point of view and the ability to build a social campaign from the initial idea through visual direction, platform strategy, programming, and execution.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable developing a campaign concept, giving creative feedback, identifying an emerging TikTok behavior, reviewing performance data, and leading a team through a high-volume publishing schedule.

What We're Looking For

This role sits at the intersection of social strategy, creative thinking, culture, and team leadership.

We are looking for someone who sees social as a creative medium rather than a distribution channel. Someone who has taste, understands what makes people stop, watch, share, comment, and participate, and knows how to turn a strong idea into a full social campaign.

The right person should be able to look at a product launch or business objective and ask, “What is the social idea?” Then build the creative and strategic framework that brings that idea to life across channels.

Manage and develop a team of four Social Media Specialists, providing clear direction, feedback, prioritization, and day-to-day leadership.
Translate the Director of Social Media’s broader strategy into channel plans, campaigns, programming, and daily execution.

Identify cultural conversations, memes, platform behaviors, emerging creators, trends, and real-time opportunities relevant to Fashion Nova.

Develop platform-specific programming rather than treating every social channel as an extension of the same content calendar.
Work with the Director of Social Media to establish content franchises, recurring series, tentpole moments, and experimentation across channels.

Social Media Video Lead (Short-Form Video)

World NGO Day Global Council · Remote · Unpaid volunteer role

About 6–8 hours a week, November 2026 to March 2027

About World NGO Day

World NGO Day, observed every year on February 27, is the international day of nonprofit and non-governmental organizations and the people who power them. It is marked in more than 140 countries and named in more than 90 languages.

The role

We are looking for a volunteer to tell the story of World NGO Day through short videos on Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and X, and sometimes LinkedIn. You will work from our branded templates, in our brand colors and fonts.

What you will do:

Every task in this role is video storytelling. You will:
•          Turn findings from the World NGO Day Global Review into short video stories about the people, countries and milestones behind the global Day.
•          Create video stories that inspire people and organizations to mark February 27 and that make it clear how they can take part.
•          Introduce the Executive Advisors of our Global Council through short video portraits.
•          Edit three to four vertical videos a week from our templates.
•          Use AI tools to edit, caption, subtitle and translate videos, and to adapt each video for each platform.

What we are looking for:

•          Strong video storytelling skills, with examples of short-form videos you have made.
•          Experience with AI video tools such as CapCut’s AI features, Runway or Descript, together with editing tools such as Edits.
•          Excellent English.
•          Reliability and the ability to meet deadlines working remotely.

What you receive:

•          A letter of appointment from the Chair of the Global Council.
•          A signed Certificate of Volunteer Service.
•          A reference letter and LinkedIn recommendation when you complete the campaign.
•          Your name credited on worldngoday.org / news.
•          Work in your portfolio that is seen around the world.

Please note

This is a voluntary role. It carries no salary, fee, commission or reimbursement of expenses. You must not attribute AI-generated voices, faces or words to Executive Advisors or any other real people without their written consent.

The Opportunity

The Head of Marketing for the Black & Veatch Infrastructure Advisory
business is responsible for creating and executing the commercial, business and marketing strategy to support the company’s growing consulting and managed services organization. As a member of the Infrastructure Advisory Leadership Team, this role is responsible for building awareness of Infrastructure Advisory and its myriad capabilities across all market segments and geographies that Black & Veatch serves. Thus, the Head of Marketing must have a track record of building management consulting and managed services businesses for critical infrastructure and energy. The right candidate will have a strong background in strategy and business planning to help identify, prioritize and develop profitable service areas for near horizon growth while nurturing new market opportunities for later horizons.

Infrastructure Advisory professionals come from a wide variety of industry executive roles and have high expectations of marketing partnership and support. This role will have a hunger to learn and understand Infrastructure Advisory services and competencies to advise the team well and drive pipeline quickly. The professional will have deep experience working in large, matrix organizations as an advocate for a growing and entrepreneurial business, be adept at working with partners and ecosystem players, and have consummate collaboration skills to integrate campaigns with sector Heads of Marketing for the clients and audiences they serve.

The Head of Marketing for Infrastructure Advisory reports to the Chief Marketing Officer for Black & Veatch and is part of the company’s Marketing Leadership Team and highly collaborative with sales and market leadership. The role is based out of the Black & Veatch world headquarters in the Kansas City area, specifically Overland Park, Kansas. It is a player-coach role intended to both lead and execute strategic marketing initiatives supporting the growth strategies of Infrastructure Advisory consulting and managed services practices. From an industry perspective, an ideal candidate would have experience building industry awareness, client demand, partnerships and client relationships for professional and managed services within several of the following target client segments: power providers including power utilities, energy developers, integrated energy/oil/energy majors, water utilities, industrial manufacturers, and data center ecosystem players including developers and co-locators.

This role requires deep marketing consultation across a variety of executive stakeholders, significant presence in working with senior leadership, autonomy and initiative in researching and creatively marketing solutions and services, and heavy collaboration across marketing and sales partners in the US and around the world. The primary market segments for the Black & Veatch Infrastructure Advisory business span power providers, energy majors and developers, mining customers, water utilities, the data center ecosystem, industrial manufacturing and commercial clients, federal clients and public agencies and utilities. Practice areas include but are not limited to: Strategy, Sustainability, Planning & Optimization; AI, Digital & Program Excellent; Asset Management and O&M; Operational Technology including Cybersecurity; Transactions & M&A; and Infrastructure Technology. The role requires a high level of business acumen to understand the P&L of businesses across Black & Veatch and the drivers of business model types generating short- and long-term revenue for the company.

Key Responsibilities

The Head of Marketing will create and advise commercial and market strategy across Black & Veatch Infrastructure Advisory teams, some of whom serve existing markets and clients of the company, while others are serving new markets and new customer groups. The organization has formidable growth targets, and the Head of Marketing is responsible for bridging between Infrastructure Advisory teams and market and geography teams to create and execute marketing campaigns, shaping perception of the maturity of the Black & Veatch Infrastructure Advisory organization, driving demand, lead capture and accelerating funnel, and nurturing client relationships through creative and poignant client engagement.

Other responsibilities:

Building and advancing business relationships within Infrastructure Advisory including the President and leadership teams, solution and market teams, as well as key relationships with market segment Presidents and leadership teams throughout Black & Veatch to build value propositions and campaigns to cross-sell services.
Market research and understanding of target segments, organization types, buyer and influencer types and engagement opportunities. Responsible for understanding the current and emerging competitive landscape across market segments and buyer groups for Infrastructure Advisory.

Defining customer decisions journeys for services areas with sales and engagement touchpoints across the buyer cycle. The role will work closely with sales, client relationship and pursuit teams to provide campaigns and tools that support the sales and lifecycle processes.
Creating and testing messaging that resonates with audiences across the segments, subsegments and buyer groups targeted with Infrastructure Advisory services, and message consistency across all platforms and channels, including digital, print, and in-person communications.
Paid media strategies, tactics and measurements to monitor and adjust campaigns, promotions and spend as part of performance marketing cycles.
Outcomes-driven demand generation and funnel-building campaigns to build awareness of Black & Veatch Infrastructure Advisory business and its portfolios.
In-person and virtual events including industry trade and Black and Veatch hosted events supporting sales, client relationships, research and industry relations.
Presence and integration of Infrastructure Advisory services across the digital landscape with stakeholders including the full client lifecycle.
Keen understanding of sales and marketing metrics and ability to set and track KPIs throughout marketing performance lifecycles and make agile adjustments for continuous performance improvement.
Leading a small team of direct reports and a much larger team of influential functional and commercial partners in collaboration and execution.
Developing relationships and collaborating with marketing, business and regional teams, searching for win-wins to grow Infrastructure Advisory as part of segment value propositions.
Collaborating with marketing leaders and peers to build and execute marketing programs from start to finish, building consensus with stakeholder groups and strong internal communications networks with sales teams and account executives across the company.
Infrastructure Advisory portfolio positioning across applicable global markets including collaborating with regional sales and marketing leaders on regional/country-specific marketing plans.

Preferred Qualifications

Proven record of building businesses and providing commercial support to grow new and current customer relationships within a matrix consulting organization.
Experience working with infrastructure and energy solutions.
Strong skills in writing in various mediums, message development, story and presentation development.
Full strategic marketing planning and execution skill set.

Strong project management, budgeting and measurement skills.
Experience marketing professional and managed services as well as technical solutions.
Minimum of 15 years of strategic marketing experience in B2B including strong digital marketing and demand generation experience.
Bachelor's degree in marketing, marketing communications, business marketing or related field. Master’s degree preferred.
Experience as a head of marketing in a matrix consulting organization with responsibilities across marketing domains supporting business sales, solution sales and regional account teams required.
Advanced marketing communications skills include writing, presenting and speaking including courageous and polished strategy pitches to senior leadership.

new_jobs.description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

Why join Coupa?

Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend
Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence
Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.

Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

The Impact of a Demand Generation Director at Coupa:

The Demand Generation Director is accountable for the integrated demand strategy and its execution across the Americas. The position owns the regional demand process end to end, including demand planning, sales play and outreach cadence design, pipeline health, and lead-to-deal conversion, and sets the foundation for how demand is generated and progressed in the Americas.

The position is the primary point of coordination between Sales, Marketing, Alliances, Advisory Services and Revenue Operations for demand matters in the Americas. It chairs the regional Demand Board, holds the integrated demand plan, and is accountable for the pipeline health and conversion outcomes that result. This is an individual contributor position that operates through influence across the demand ecosystem rather than through direct authority.

What You'll Do:

Demand strategy and planning

Leads the regional demand process, including planning, coordination and analysis, and is accountable for the integrated demand plan for the Americas
Develops integrated demand strategies that align marketing, sales and partner activity to regional pipeline and revenue objectives
Sets the demand planning calendar and the inputs required from each contributing function, and holds those functions to the agreed plan
Determines where demand investment is directed by segment, solution and route to market, and recommends reallocation where performance requires it

Demand execution and sales plays

Designs tactical sales plays and outreach cadences tailored to specific target audiences and aligned to business priorities, in partnership with Sales, Marketing and Sales Enablement
Accountable for the execution of the demand plan in the Americas, including sequencing, coverage of priority accounts and segments, and completion against the agreed calendar
Partners with the Revenue Systems directors on the platforms and configuration that support demand motions, including prospecting and contact data, sales engagement and cadence management, and submits requirements through the established intake process
Accountable for adoption and performance of the sales plays and cadences released into the region, and for revision or retirement of those that do not perform

Pipeline health and conversion

Accountable for a healthy and predictable pipeline of qualified opportunities for the regional sales organization, measured against defined coverage and quality standards
Uses data and analytics to track the performance of demand generation initiatives, and identifies the drivers of variance between plan and actual
Accountable for lead-to-deal conversion improvement in the Americas, including diagnosis of conversion loss by stage, source and segment, and the remediation plan
Tracks performance and progress of demand activity against pipeline health metrics, and reports status on a defined cadence

Cross-functional coordination and governance

Collaborates with Sales, Marketing, Alliances, Advisory Services and other functions to develop a coordinated and integrated demand plan that meets business goals
Hosts the regional Demand Board and associated planning activities to track progress and align the demand ecosystem on priorities, commitments and outcomes
Escalates to the Leader, Demand Orchestration where cross-functional commitments, resourcing or prioritization cannot be resolved in the Americas
Fosters a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement and excellence across the demand ecosystem, and drives improvement of the processes and tools the ecosystem depends upon

Market insight and solution knowledge

Monitors and analyzes market trends, customer behaviors and the competitive landscape, and applies that analysis to demand planning and play design
Maintains a working understanding of areas of strength and weakness across the relevant solution portfolio, and reflects that understanding in targeting and messaging priorities
Partners with Product Marketing and Competitive Intelligence to keep demand activity current with positioning and competitive changes

Insight to leadership

Provides proactive insight to leadership on demand planning, forecasting and execution, including risks to pipeline coverage and the actions required
Represents the regional demand position in planning and review cycles, including quarterly business reviews and annual planning
Translates demand performance into the commercial implications leadership requires for decision-making

Performance Measures

Pipeline coverage and quality against regional targets, by segment and solution
Lead-to-opportunity and opportunity-to-close conversion rates against baselines
Contribution of demand activity to qualified pipeline and closed revenue in the Americas
Delivery of the demand plan against committed scope and calendar
Adoption and performance of released sales plays and outreach cadences
Demand Board and planning cadence operating as designed, with documented commitments and follow-through
Accuracy and timeliness of demand reporting and insight to leadership

What You Will Bring to Coupa:

Bachelor's degree in an analytical discipline such as Finance, Business, Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
Ten or more years of experience in business-to-business demand generation, demand management or a closely related go-to-market function
Demonstrated track record of developing and implementing successful demand management strategies at scale
Strong analytical capability, including the ability to interpret complex data sets and make data-driven decisions
Demonstrated experience designing sales plays and outreach cadences, and measuring their performance
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and to build durable internal relationships, including with senior stakeholders, without direct authority
Strong financial and business acumen, and demonstrated problem-solving capability, including the ability to translate process into value-adding business activity
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced, changing environment
Demonstrated leadership capability, including the ability to set direction, and to inspire and motivate teams the position does not manage
Demonstrated commitment to challenging, improving and innovating at both a personal and an organizational level

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience in large technology companies, in a multi-segment, multi-region organization with an established partner channel
Working knowledge of the platforms that support demand motions, including CRM, sales engagement and cadence management, prospecting and contact data, and intent or account-based marketing platforms
Experience integrating partner and advisory motions into demand planning and execution
Prior experience in a quota-carrying, sales management or field-facing role

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a mission-driven growth marketer to become our hands-on owner of the paid search channel. Paid search is currently the largest of our digital paid media channels and a significant driver of enrollments, so your work directly ties to furthering Hinge Health’s mission to improve the lives of people suffering from chronic conditions.

You’ll join the paid media pod, the fastest-growing group of channels on the Growth team, with real autonomy to decide what the work is and how it gets done. As we launch new products, you’ll build the keyword strategy that takes Hinge Health into new categories and puts our care in front of more people who need it. The right candidate wants to go deep on one channel and loves working on both strategy and the details.

What You’ll Accomplish

Own paid search end to end: Build, launch, and manage campaigns across Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising, covering branded and non-branded search, Performance Max, and related formats.
Shape the channel strategy: Translate insights from new product launches, audience research, and company goals into channel strategy and experimentation roadmap.
Turn data into experiments: Find insights in the numbers and use them to design tests on messaging, ad formats, and other ad features.
Build optimized workflows: Create the playbooks, reporting, and automation, including AI-assisted workflows, that help the channel run smoothly, and accelerate test and learn cycles.
Own channel reporting: Create regular performance reporting on pacing, efficiency, and test results, and translate results into clear next steps.
Manage the platform relationship: Serve as our point of contact with Google account representatives, staying current on new features, betas, and policy changes that help us scale.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Work with the creative team on developing ad creative, with Data Science on tracking and measurement, and with the broader Growth team on how paid search fits into the overall acquisition strategy.

Who You Are

An owner of the channel: You own paid search end to end from the idea through strategy, execution, and optimization.
A data-driven experimenter: You dig into the data to find an insight, then design an experiment around it. You’re driven by curiosity and love to see which experiments work.
A detail-minded strategist: You are meticulous, and you own your numbers. You can also step back from the account and think about where the channel as a whole should go.
A Learn-it-all: You are always willing to learn and improve, whether that’s a new Google Ads feature, a new ad platform, or a better way to run your own week.
A mission-driven marketer: You care about making quality care easier to get, and you want your work tied to that.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of experience managing paid search campaigns, including hands-on Google Ads work managing bid settings, determining campaign structure, and conducting keyword research.
Proven track record of managing meaningful budgets and hitting acquisition growth and efficiency goals
Experience using Mode, Mixpanel, Google Analytics or similar tools to build reports and analyze performance

Preferred Qualifications

Proven success managing a large paid search program, with budgets of at least $3 million annually
Demonstrated use of Claude Code, Codex, or similar tools to build workflows that support campaign strategy and execution
Working knowledge of SEO and AEO and how they intersect with paid search
Experience running structured tests on ad copy, landing pages, and other campaign settings and translating results into action
Hands-on Microsoft Advertising campaign management
A track record of testing emerging ad formats, including ChatGPT Ads
Background in healthcare or another regulated industry

On remote days, employees are expected to work during core business hours with flexibility. The office is part of a dog-friendly workplace program, and while travel is not regularly required, occasional off-site/on-site events may occur. About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2,900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth.com.

ClassDojo's goal is to give every child on Earth an education they love.

We started by building a powerful network for communication. ClassDojo’s flagship app is the #1 communication app connecting K-12 teachers, children, and families globally. Teachers use it to share what’s happening throughout the day through photos, videos, and messages that make parents feel like they’re there. It’s actively used in over 95% of US schools, reaching over 45 million children in 180 countries, with a team of just around 200 people [1]. We are now beginning to use this network to give kids the best learning experiences in the world, far beyond those a standard school can provide.

We hire for talent density. Our team comprises the most talented, entrepreneurial, and innovative teammates from around the world, with experience in education and large scale consumer internet companies, including Instagram, Netflix, Dropbox, Stripe, Uber, Y Combinator, and more. We’re building a company where the most talented people want to work. We believe you’ll do the best work of your life here—and you’ll pioneer the future of education, too.

What You’ll Do

As Growth Marketing Lead, you’ll own how ClassDojo reaches new families beyond our existing network. For two exciting consumer products: Dojo Sparks, and Dojo Islands. Both products have grown fast, with Islands reaching millions of kids every month. You’ll set the strategy and personally execute on high-leverage acquisition experiments—building, testing, and scaling channels that drive net-new paid users for our consumer products.

This is a high-impact, high-autonomy, IC-first role. You’ll operate like a one-person growth marketing team initially: setting direction, running experiments end to end, analyzing results, and scaling what works. Over time, you’ll help build the systems, processes, and partnerships that allow growth to compound efficiently.

You’ll partner closely with Product, Creative, Data, and Marketing leaders, and work alongside another growth leader focused on internal ClassDojo network growth. Your mandate is external acquisition—finding repeatable ways to reach and convert families who don’t yet know ClassDojo.

This role requires a builder’s mindset: someone who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly without perfect resources, and uses strong judgment and data to decide where to double down.

You Will

Set and own the strategy for new user acquisition across paid and unpaid channels, with an early focus on social and influencer partnerships
Personally run growth experiments end to end—defining hypotheses, launching tests, analyzing results, and making scale/kill decisions
Identify and validate new acquisition channels through scrappy, manual approaches first, then scale successful bets via agencies, tooling, and automation
Establish clear success metrics and ROI thresholds to guide investment and prioritization
Partner closely with Product and Creative and Product Marketing to test value propositions, landing experiences, and onboarding flows that improve conversion
Build a durable experimentation and measurement framework that enables fast iteration across messaging, targeting, and funnel steps
Leverage external resources and modern tools (including AI) to maximize impact without overbuilding internal teams
Help shape the long-term growth marketing muscle at ClassDojo, with potential to take on people leadership as impact is proven

You Will Be a Match If

new_jobs.title: Senior Growth Marketing Strategist
new_jobs.description:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

Client Strategy & Relationships

Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

Paid Media Performance

Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

Copy & Creative Strategy

Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

Tracking & Funnel Execution

Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility
Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Experience

Financial services marketing
Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
Video sales letter marketing
High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
Performance marketing agency experience
Direct-response advertising

NOTE: Upper Compensation Range ($115K+)
Candidates considered for the upper compensation range must demonstrate hands-on experience developing and optimizing direct-response ad copy, video scripts/VSLs, creative hooks, messaging angles, and conversion-focused funnels. They should be able to demonstrate measurable improvements in campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and booked appointments resulting from their creative contributions. Experience in financial services, RIA marketing, and compliance-sensitive advertising is strongly preferred.

How You Work

You take ownership. When performance drops, you investigate the account, identify the likely cause, develop a strategy, and act. You're comfortable moving between media buying, client strategy, copy, creative, and funnel performance without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You can explain complex performance issues clearly, make decisions based on data, and operate with a high level of accountability. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people waiting for someone else to make the call.

Benefits

Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays
Training & Development
Work From Home
Flexible Schedule
Performance Bonus

Partner with marketing and LOB stakeholders to align website experiences with business objectives, product priorities, and client needs. Drive content, experience, and functionality enhancements across Truist.com through collaboration with marketing, content, UX Design & Research, SEO, authoring, QA, and technology teams. Research, develop and execute strategies for Truist digital channels which increase acquisition, retention, profitability, and cross-sell of clients across Truist’s Small Business and Wholesale site sections and product lines. Primary focus on Small Business deposit products and digital banking services.
Partner with marketing partners, channel leads, and platform product owners to develop product specific roadmaps which assist in achieving revenue goals through digital marketing strategies.
Demonstrate a solid understanding of the business owner behavior model and user journeys, and how both are applied to banking products and services. Increase Truist product awareness, consideration, and acquisition by aligning business needs with Truist offerings.
Leverage web analytics, site performance data, voice-of-client and user experience research to develop and refine digital marketing strategies, drive qualified traffic, improve conversion rates, and enhance client experiences across digital devices. Maintain appropriate reporting capabilities to establish and track KPIs and communicate the value of marketing placements and digital marketing strategies to business marketing partners and senior management.
Stay current on the changes taking place in the digital environment. Research and evaluate industry trends, the competitive environment, and emerging technologies. Adjust strategies accordingly to ensure Truist remains at a competitive advantage.
Strong quantitative, technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with an aptitude for measuring results and identifying actionable insights.

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration or related field, or equivalent education and related training
Five years of related experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience
In-depth knowledge of principles, practices, theories, and/or methodologies associated with the Marketing discipline (e.g., Marketing P’s, Market research, analytics, digital)
Experience managing projects or project work streams and works as an Individual Contributor
Knowledge of the industry's competitive landscape and the factors that differentiate Truist and its competitors in the market
Ability to interpret and explain complex information to a range of audiences and build consensus among different stakeholders
Ability to provide direction, and mentor less experienced teammates
Proficient in Excel and PowerPoint

Preferred Qualifications:

Master's degree or MBA and previous experience in the banking industry
Experience developing digital marketing strategies that drive traffic and conversions
Demonstrated ability to apply agile marketing methodologies and processes to large enterprise, cross-functional teams
Ability to develop strategies that break long-term goals into short term wins to facilitate learning, quick iteration, with shorter time to market and return on investment
Working knowledge of various programming languages (Java, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, XML, Python, SQL)
Working knowledge of American Disabilities Act (ACT) compliance requirements
Experience with Adobe products (AEM, Target and Target, Analytics, Audience Manager and Adobe Cloud)
Certified in the use of email service providers, marketing automation and CRM platforms (e.g. Salesforce, Marketo, IBM Watson, Eloqua, Epsilon, Acoustic, Adobe Campaign, Pardot, etc.)
Experience with API development, ad servers, dynamic tag managers, market automation platforms, content management systems, A/B multivariate testing and personalization tools
Excellent understanding of HTML for email and ability to code templates, revise modular layouts and provide both strategic and technical direction to web developers
Proficiency in algebraic Boolean logic expressions for building queries and hyper-segmentation

Visual / Audio / Speaking

Able to access and interpret client information received from the computer and able to hear and speak with individuals in person and on the phone.

Manual Dexterity / Keyboarding

Able to work standard office equipment, including PC keyboard and mouse, copy/fax machines, and printers.

Availability

Able to work all hours scheduled, including overtime as directed by manager/supervisor and required by business need.

new_jobs.description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries to make life and our environment safer, healthier, and more sustainable. From the food you eat to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with organizations around the world to ensure products are safe, compliant, and of the highest quality.

With more than 58,000 employees across 900 laboratories in over 50 countries, Eurofins is a global leader in laboratory testing, regulatory support, and scientific services. Our Medical Device division partners with manufacturers throughout the product lifecycle, providing testing, consulting, and regulatory services that help bring safe and effective medical technologies to market.

Job Description

Eurofins is seeking a Marketing Communications Manager - Medical Devices
to lead the development and execution of strategic marketing programs that support the growth of our Medical Device Testing and Consulting business.

This role will drive integrated marketing initiatives that increase brand awareness, generate qualified leads, and position Eurofins as a trusted partner for medical device manufacturers. The successful candidate will translate complex scientific, testing, and regulatory concepts into compelling, customer-focused messaging that resonates with engineering, quality, regulatory, R&D, and executive stakeholders.

Reporting to the Marketing Director, this position will collaborate closely with business leaders, technical subject matter experts, sales teams, regulatory consultants, and external agencies to deliver measurable business impact.

Essential Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns that support Medical Device Testing and Consulting services.
Create compelling content for websites, email campaigns, case studies, webinars, sales materials, presentations, and social media.
Translate complex scientific, testing, and regulatory information into clear, customer-focused messaging.
Partner with technical experts and business leaders to develop thought leadership and industry-focused content.
Manage demand generation programs, lead nurturing activities, and marketing automation initiatives.
Collaborate with sales teams to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and pipeline growth.
Track and analyze campaign performance, providing recommendations to improve engagement and ROI.
Support medical device industry trade shows, conferences, webinars, and customer events.
Coordinate agency partners, project timelines, budgets, and marketing deliverables.
Maintain brand consistency across all customer-facing communications and marketing materials.
Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, and market opportunities within the medical device sector.

Qualifications

The Ideal Candidate

8-10 years of marketing communications experience in medical devices, healthcare, life sciences, laboratory services, or another regulated B2B industry.
Proven success developing campaigns that drive brand awareness, lead generation, and business growth.
Strong understanding of medical device markets and customer needs.
Skilled at translating technical concepts into clear, compelling marketing messages.
Able to influence cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Education & Experience
